from.place: the ind-system Hom computation in the proof of the pre-derived adjunction

title: Hom into an essentially constant ind-system value is the colimit of Hom sets
statement: Let $J$ be a filtered category, $\mathcal C$ a category, and $F:J\to\mathcal C$ a diagram that is essentially constant as an ind-object with value $X$ [def-pc-essentially-constant-ind-diagram]. For every object $Y$ of $\mathcal C$, the canonical map $\varinjlim_{j\in J}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(Y,F(j))\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(Y,X)$ induced by the cocone maps $p_j:F(j)\to X$ of the essential constancy is a bijection.

source.place: Stacks Tag 0FND, label lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general, proof line 9515, first equality; Categories Tag 05PY, label categories-lemma-characterize-essentially-constant-ind

proof.text: Use the cocone p selected from the essential-constancy witness, and unpack its section s at j0 and its factorization clause [def-pc-essentially-constant-ind-diagram]. The given canonical descent is already well-defined by Mathlib Functor.descColimitType and coconeTypesEquiv; its component at j sends f to f composed with p_j.

Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Functor.CoconeTypes.descColimitType_injective_iff_of_isFiltered' to reduce injectivity to two arrows f,f' from Y to F(j) at the SAME stage j with equal composites into X. The factorization clause provides k and b:j->k with F(b)=p_j composed with s composed with F(a). Associativity and congruence of postcomposition with s composed with F(a) turn the assumed equality into f composed with F(b)=f' composed with F(b), exactly the criterion. No separate common-stage or coequalization construction is needed.

Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Functor.CoconeTypes.descColimitType_surjective_iff. For any g:Y->X use g composed with s at j0. Associativity and s composed with p_j0=id_X give its image g. Combine injectivity and surjectivity to obtain the canonical bijection.

lean.statement: theorem essentiallyConstantInd_hom_colimit_bijective {J : Type uJ} {C : Type uC} [Category.{vJ} J] [Category.{vC} C] (F : J ⥤ C) (X : C) (h : IsEssentiallyConstantIndDiagram F X) (Y : C) : Function.Bijective ((F ⋙ coyoneda.obj (op Y)).descColimitType ((F ⋙ coyoneda.obj (op Y)).coconeTypesEquiv.symm ((coyoneda.obj (op Y)).mapCocone { pt := X, ι := h.2.choose })))
lean.note: The cocone maps are selected from h.2 by Classical.choose. Mathlib Functor.ColimitType realizes the set colimit in Type (max uJ vC), avoiding any smallness or HasColimit hypothesis.
